image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a large common iguana resting in grassy vegetation. The image focuses on the head, neck, and upper torso. The iguana displays a prominent dorsal crest with reddish-brown spines, rough textured grey-green scales, and a large circular subtympanic shield below the ear area. The background consists of blurred green foliage and dry twigs.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The texture is highly detailed, showing clear differentiation between the smaller granular scales on the body and the larger, pebbled scales on the head and jaw.
